experiment: BT-1 bat-tracking lane (hitters): pWOBA residual arm + xHEM-style blend arm

v1.note: legacy convention; the shipped gate verdicts were established here

v2.target: wOBA(Y+1) (within-OUTCOME-season z-score removes the era term)
v2.bootstrap: player-clustered (all of a player's pairs move together), season-stratified (players stratified by first predictor season); 2000 reps, seeded; CIs are wider by design
v2.note: transition-cycle companion; future gates must pre-declare v1 or v2

harness.pair_rule: Y->Y+1 pairs kept only when the OUTCOME season is complete (past Nov 15). Partial-year targets (e.g. mid-2026) are a defect, dropped under BOTH conventions.
harness.predictors: unrounded *_raw model scores (display rounding never enters evals)
interpretation_rules: existing VALIDATED ships STAND even if v2 weakens them; a reversal is flagged to the owner, not auto-reverted
ledgered NO-SHIPs are re-baselined under v2 but never revived by v2 alone
X-R2 / X-S2 flips are not promised

data_source.extraction: embedded `const data = [...]` JSON (the csv=true export omits the swing-path fields); the bare `season` param is ignored by the endpoint, seasonStart/seasonEnd required

protocol.pre_registered: 2026-07-23, frozen before any results were computed
folds: 2025->2026 (PARTIAL outcome through 2026-07-23; kept by pre-registered deviation from harness rule 4, flagged; complete-only sensitivity reported)
protocol.ledger_position: distinct from the CLOSED pwoba_ev_arm (EV/barrel residual), xwOBA-allowed and CSW-xK lanes; bat tracking is swing-measured, not batted-ball-outcome
protocol.small_n_honesty: exactly two transition folds exist for this lane (bat tracking begins 2024); one fold has a partial outcome season; a PASS would still be provisional and would queue re-confirmation after 2026 completes

arm_a_pwoba_residual.candidate: bt_corrected = woba_proj + cross-fitted OLS(residual ~ z(bat_speed) + z(squared_up_rate) + z(attack_angle))

gate.bar: pooled two-fold iid paired bootstrap lo95(rho(bt_corrected) - rho(woba_proj)) > 0; v1, seed 20260723, 2000 reps

arm_b_descriptive_blend.candidate: bt_blend = 0.595*z(est_woba) + 0.255*z(hem_plus_raw) + 0.15*z(bt_composite); composite = mean z(bat_speed, squared_up_rate, blast_rate); weights frozen a priori

descriptive_context_not_gated.question: same-season Spearman vs the wOBA - xwOBA luck gap: BT contact-quality composite vs EV composite (mean z of avg_hit_speed, brl_pa, ev95percent)

gate.bar: pooled two-fold iid paired bootstrap lo95(rho(bt_blend) - rho(fwdhem_incumbent)) > 0 vs next-season wOBA; v1, seed 20260723, 2000 reps

verdicts.arm_a_summary: rho(bt_corrected)=0.4698 vs rho(woba_proj)=0.4725 on 468 pooled pairs; gap CI {'mean': -0.0027, 'lo95': -0.0164, 'hi95': 0.0121}. Gate FAILED under v1 and v2 and in the complete-outcome-only sensitivity; the cross-fitted residual correction does not add forward signal beyond the incumbent pWOBA. Lane CLOSED as tested.
verdicts.arm_b_summary: rho(bt_blend)=0.4184 vs rho(fwdhem_incumbent)=0.4076 on 482 pooled pairs; gap CI {'mean': 0.0109, 'lo95': -0.0009, 'hi95': 0.024}. Gate FAILED (directionally positive mean gap, lo95 below zero under both conventions and in the complete-outcome-only sensitivity). The candidate DOES beat xwoba_z_alone and the BT composite alone at lo95 > 0, but the pre-registered bar is the shipped fwdHEM+ incumbent, and it is not cleared. NULL; the one honest keep-alive is a re-test on the identical frozen protocol after the 2026 season completes (Nov 15), which adds no new researcher degrees of freedom.
verdicts.descriptive_note: Same-season luck-gap context (not gated): BT composite vs EV composite Spearman with the wOBA - xwOBA gap: 2024 BT -0.1794 vs EV -0.1814; 2025 BT -0.2188 vs EV -0.2104; 2026 BT -0.2799 vs EV -0.2735.
